fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $38,000, due in full at signing. During 2025, fees ranged from $0 to $38,000 due to various programs: (1) Franchise Option Program — full refund of IFF in exchange for a 4% increase in Continuing Royalty rate for 10 years; (2) Military/First Responder Program — 20% reduction for qualifying military or first responders on first franchise; (3) Multi-Unit Program — 25% reduction on second and additional franchises when purchasing 3 or more simultaneously; (4) Hard to Serve/Underserved Markets Program — up to 10% discount; (5) Conversion Franchise Program — full waiver of IFF for qualified conversion franchisees. All waivers/reductions are at franchisor's sole discretion.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an initial franchise fee of $38,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee"). The Initial Franchise Fee is due in full at the time you sign the Franchise Agreement, unless we offer to finance all or a portion of it for you. ... During 2025 our franchise offering included waivers, discounts and refunds such that our Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $0 to $38,000.
